reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes copying selected Solana meme-coin wallets through an automated bot and directs viewers toward a highlighted wallet, a partnered trading-calls group, and a recommended bot. It links this activity to unusually large reported returns, including more than 1,000 Solana and a seven-day PNL of approximately 201.2%, supporting a high-return solicitation interpretation. the available video evidence notes that the returns are not established as typical, guaranteed, independently verified, or actually obtained by viewers, and that risk warnings do not remove the video's own promotion of copy trading and related services.

overall, guys, I think TradeWizbot can be a beneficial tool for us to copy trade with
Copy Trade Bot: https://cutt.ly/stWCWRrQ

opening.argument: The presentation is unusually explicit that meme-coin copy trading is risky and that viewers should limit their exposure. The speaker says to use only funds they can afford to lose, calls the activity “all a risk,” and acknowledges that even a trailing stop has both benefits and drawbacks. That is inconsistent with a deceptive assurance of safe or dependable returns: the speaker expressly discusses losses, uncertainty, farming, failed trades, and the possibility that a coin never recovers. The warnings are directly connected to the recommended activity, not merely absent boilerplate, and support treating this as a candid technology and trading tutorial.

citations.quote: only put funds on here that you can afford to lose

there's a give and take with that
nobody really knows i wish that i had a crystal ball to let you know

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution emphasizes favorable examples, but favorable examples do not erase the speaker’s repeated risk disclosures. The recommendation is expressly limited to funds the viewer can afford to lose, and the speaker discusses failed trades and changing strategy rather than promising a result. Calling a tool beneficial is not the same as guaranteeing profit, especially where the speaker says the strategy has been rough and must be reassessed.

citations.quote: it really hasn't been very great for me leverage trading-wise
I really need to kinda rethink my strategy
only put funds on here that you can afford to lose

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Risk warnings do not neutralize the central solicitation. The video still recommends a bot for copying selected wallets and describes unusually large wallet results. Saying viewers may lose money is compatible with promoting a risky product; it does not establish that the reported returns are typical, verified, or achievable by viewers. The warnings therefore qualify the pitch but do not change what viewers are being encouraged to do.

opening.argument: The content is structured as an operational tutorial and personal evaluation, not as a promise of passive income. Its title calls it a “Full Guide Tutorial,” the description lists instructional sections on finding wallets and configuring bot settings, and the speaker explains criteria such as win rate, holding time, quick flips, and farm risk. He also rejects some wallets after investigation and explains why apparent performance can be misleading. Showing how a trading interface works, comparing candidate wallets, and describing the creator’s own evolving strategy are ordinary educational and technology-demonstration activities, even if the subject is speculative trading.

How to set up your copy trade bot full walk through and set up step by step
we want wallets that have high roi high win rate low quick flip percentage
this wallet probably isn't the best now

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution infers solicitation from the subject matter and links, but the actual discussion is evaluative and instructional. The speaker identifies weaknesses in wallets, explains that a high win rate can hide unrealized losses, and says he would not copy a wallet that no longer meets his criteria. Those qualifications are evidence of analysis, not certification that every wallet or tool will produce the displayed results.

citations.quote: this wallet probably isn't the best now
these wallets are not perfect
their win percentage is skewed

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A tutorial can still function as promotion. The walkthrough does not merely explain software neutrally: it concludes that the recommended bot is beneficial and says the speaker will use it for copy trading. The wallet analysis supplies a path to act, while the favorable conclusion and linked services encourage adoption. Technical detail describes the mechanism; it does not disprove a promotional purpose.

opening.argument: At most, this is ordinary promotion of a trading tool and related information service, not evidence of a scam mechanism. The materials identify a bot, a calls group, and research tools, while the visible interface shows configurable copy-trading parameters and auto-sell controls rather than a request for credentials, a deposit to the creator, or recruitment of other participants. The speaker specifically tells viewers to keep funds in their own wallet and use the bot only with money they can afford to lose. The evidence therefore shows software configuration and a risky service recommendation, but not guaranteed returns, a required payment to unlock profits, credential harvesting, or downline income.

citations.quote: only put funds on here that you can afford to lose
have it on your own wallet and just send it back and forth

rebuttal.rebuttal: The existence of referral links or a recommended service is not itself a scam mechanism. The description also contains explicit warnings that the creator will not ask viewers to invest or send money, and the speaker advises viewers to retain control of their funds. Reported performance figures may be examples from a dashboard, but the materials do not turn them into a guarantee or establish that viewers must pay the creator to receive returns.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing elements do not make the promotion ordinary commerce. The relevant mechanism is automated copying of trades through a bot, paired with favorable wallet-performance claims and links to the bot and calls group. A viewer need not send money directly to the speaker for the content to solicit risky financial activity. The displayed PNL and claims about more than 1,000 Solana are not shown to be representative, independently verified, or reproducible for viewers.
